title: Build with Gemini XPRIZE
short_description: Build innovative AI-powered solutions using Gemini to solve real-world challenges.
full_description: A global challenge inviting developers, engineers, and designers to build groundbreaking AI applications on the Gemini platform. Teams compete across multiple tracks to demonstrate real impact, usability, and technical excellence. Finalists present live to a panel of industry experts and VCs.

title: CloudScale Global Challenge
short_description: Engineer scalable, cost-optimized cloud solutions on AWS for real business problems.
full_description: A 48-hour challenge focused on architecture, scalability, and cost efficiency. Participants design and deploy cloud-native applications on AWS, with workshops from certified solutions architects. Tracks include serverless, data platforms, and migration strategies.

title: DevHack Web Innovation Sprint
short_description: Ship a production-ready web app in 48 hours using modern frameworks and edge infrastructure.
full_description: A fast-paced web development sprint where teams ship polished, production-ready applications using Next.js, edge functions, and modern tooling. Emphasis on performance, accessibility, and developer experience. Winners are deployed permanently and featured on partner blogs.

title: Zero Trust CTF & Build
short_description: Hunt vulnerabilities in a simulated enterprise and build defensive security tooling.
full_description: Part capture-the-flag, part buildathon. Teams first exploit a deliberately vulnerable corporate network, then build open-source defensive tooling to detect and mitigate the same attacks. Mentored by security researchers and blue-team veterans.

title: DataBridge Insight Challenge
short_description: Turn messy real-world datasets into actionable intelligence with modern data engineering.
full_description: A data science and engineering challenge built around lakehouse architecture. Participants clean, transform, and model large real-world datasets, then build interactive dashboards and predictive pipelines. Mentors from Databricks and Spark committers available throughout.

title: ChainForge Web3 Buildathon
short_description: Design decentralized apps and smart contracts that push the limits of Web3.
full_description: A three-week virtual buildathon for builders exploring decentralized finance, identity, DAOs, and on-chain data. Teams ship dApps on Ethereum and L2s with direct grants, auditing support, and introductions to leading protocols.

title: EdgeSense IoT Innovate
short_description: Connect hardware and intelligence to build IoT products for smart environments.
full_description: Hands-on hardware hackathon where teams prototype connected devices using NXP kits, sensors, and edge AI. Focus areas include smart agriculture, industrial monitoring, and connected health. Hardware provided on-site; winning teams receive distribution support.

title: PayChain FinTech Fusion
short_description: Reimagine payments, banking, and financial inclusion with modern APIs.
full_description: A fintech buildathon focused on payments, lending, fraud detection, and financial inclusion. Teams build with live sandbox APIs, compete for integration grants, and pitch to fintech investors. Compliance and security experts provide mentorship.

title: MedAI Health Solutions Sprint
short_description: Apply AI and ML to improve diagnostics, care coordination, and patient outcomes.
full_description: A healthcare-focused hackathon tackling real clinical challenges with responsible AI. Tracks span diagnostics support, mental health, clinical trial matching, and patient engagement. Datasets are de-identified; clinicians and regulatory experts join as mentors.

title: GreenCode Climate Hackathon
short_description: Build software that measures, reduces, or reverses environmental impact at scale.
full_description: A global sustainability challenge for engineers building climate solutions — from carbon tracking and renewable energy management to circular economy platforms. Submissions are judged on measurable impact, feasibility, and scalability. Winners get accelerator access and pilot partnerships.
